subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Oman quiz and the dolphin centre narrative
outcomes: Ask and answer quiz questions about Oman and give scores
Read a narrative text and answer short-answer questions

tf.s: Oman's coastline is over 3000 kilometres long.
tf.why: Yes, Oman has a very long coastline of over 3000 km.

tf.s: Oman shares borders with Saudi Arabia, Yemen and the UAE.
tf.why: Well done: these are Oman's three neighbouring countries.

tf.s: Bears are one of the wild animals found in Oman.
tf.why: Bears are not found in Oman; this was the reasoning question in the quiz.

tf.s: Bahla Fort became a UNESCO heritage site in 1987.
tf.why: Correct: Bahla Fort was listed by UNESCO in 1987.

tf.s: Masirah Island is about 150 kilometres from the mainland.
tf.why: Masirah is only 15 kilometres from the mainland.
Oman borders three countries: Saudi Arabia, Yemen and the UAE.

tf.s: The text about the dolphin centre is a narrative essay.
tf.why: Yes, it tells a story of an experience, so it is a narrative.

tf.s: In a quiz show, the host is the person who answers the questions.
tf.why: The host asks the questions; the contestant answers them.

tf.s: A contestant is a person who takes part in a competition or quiz.
tf.why: Right: contestants compete to win the quiz.

tf.s: A narrative essay mainly gives facts and figures without telling a story.
tf.why: A narrative essay tells a story about events or an experience.

boxes.q: Who asks the questions in a quiz show?
boxes.why: The host runs the show and asks the questions.
Saudi Arabia, Yemen and the UAE border Oman.

boxes.q: Which fort is a UNESCO heritage site?
boxes.why: Bahla Fort became a UNESCO site in 1987.

boxes.q: How far is Masirah Island from the mainland?
boxes.why: Masirah Island is 15 kilometres from the mainland.

boxes.q: What type of text tells the story of a visit to a dolphin centre?
boxes.why: Stories of personal experiences are narrative essays.

boxes.q: What does a dolphin eat, according to the reading?
boxes.why: The text says the dolphin eats only fish.
A quiz is a test or game with questions to answer.

boxes.q: What is the name of the swim in the dolphin text?
boxes.why: The text mentions the Royal Swim with the dolphins.

boxes.q: In the pair quiz, what is each score out of?
boxes.why: Partners scored each other out of 10.

boxes.q: In which year did Bahla Fort join the UNESCO list?

hunt.q: Masirah is ... km from the mainland.
The person who asks quiz questions
A person who takes part in a quiz
The famous fort in Bahla is a ... site

o: Saudi Arabia, Yemen and the UAE
mcq.why: Oman's land neighbours are Saudi Arabia, Yemen and the UAE.
Oman has a long coastline of over 3000 km.

mcq.q: Which place became a UNESCO heritage site in 1987?
mcq.why: Bahla Fort was added to the UNESCO list in 1987.

mcq.q: What is a 'host' in a quiz show?
o: The person who presents the show and asks questions
The person who answers the questions
The place where the show is filmed
mcq.why: The host presents the quiz and asks the contestants questions.

mcq.q: Your partner answers 7 of the 10 quiz questions correctly. What score do you give?
mcq.why: Each correct answer is one point, so 7 correct answers give 7 out of 10.

mcq.q: A text begins: 'Last summer my family and I visited a dolphin centre...' What kind of text is it?
mcq.why: It tells a story of past events, which is a narrative.

mcq.q: Which question would a quiz host ask about Oman's islands?
o: How far is Masirah Island from the mainland?
Where did you buy that bag?
mcq.why: A quiz asks fact questions, like the distance of Masirah from the mainland.

mcq.q: Leopards, wolves, bears: which animal is NOT found in Oman, and why is it the odd one out?
o: Bears, because the other two live in Oman
Leopards, because they live only in Africa
None, all three live in Oman
mcq.why: Leopards and wolves are found in Oman, but bears are not.

mcq.q: Why is the dolphin-centre text called a narrative essay?
o: It tells a story of an experience in order
It argues for and against an idea
mcq.why: Narratives describe events and experiences as a story.

mcq.q: What is the main difference between a host and a contestant?
o: The host asks the questions; the contestant answers them
The host answers; the contestant asks
Both of them only watch the show
The contestant writes the questions for the host
mcq.why: Their roles are opposite: one asks, the other answers.
